notes:
Footage tools: Stabilize, upscale, interpolate, match colors and remove backgrounds from video, or separate audio into stems. Preview resource estimates and required downloads before starting. The optional IS-Net model is for non-commercial use only.
Editing: Add audio and video tool results to a video, with undo; generated music can be placed as a music bed. Detect silence, stillness, adaptive shots and fades through agent and CLI tools.
Character animation: A new agent skill provides reusable character rigs, cutout tools, motion checks and sound cues.
macOS access: BaoCut explains when Full Disk Access is needed and helps open System Settings for downloads and other protected files.
Fixes: Codex image jobs use the image generated in their own turn. Changed Codex executable paths and custom-provider sign-in are handled more accurately. OpenAI-compatible endpoints without a model list can be verified.
Task and model settings: Text generation tasks show their instructions; model folder changes explain active blockers when attempted. Development CLI homes use the matching repository Runtime, and media analysis resolves asset paths correctly.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
